text: Welcome to Waiz, Jordan

Your reverse-mortgage acquisition engine is built, checked, and ready to go live. This kit is the leave-behind from your launch call. It is not homework. It is the map — what is live, how to run Week 1, where every file lives, and who to reach when something needs attention.

Most agencies hand you a login and wish you luck. We are pulling up the hood. When you understand the system, you show up better on your calls, you use the tools correctly, and you get more out of every dollar you invest with us.
The PDF is the conversation. The Drive folder is the vault. Anything that changes — ads, swipe files, recordings — lives in Drive so this document never goes stale.

text: 03  Week 1 operator checklist
Reverse mortgage. You and your VA work new leads. The bot and the drip support you — they do not replace the phone.
When a lead hits, work it. Do not batch until tonight.
Call first. Text if you miss. Leave a short voicemail — then move on.
Never end a live conversation without the next step on the calendar (BAMFAM).
Update the disposition before you touch the next name.
If they text back, call. Do not write a novel in the thread.
Stay in Slack. If something looks broken, say so the same day.

06  First 30 days
Weeks 1–4 are a test. We are collecting data across ads, audiences, and angles. No single combination has earned the whole budget yet. That is the work — not a delay.
